platformAgent.title: AI Agent Workbench
platformAgent.description: Run enterprise agents and browser automation with permission controls and human approval for sensitive actions.

permissions.deniedDescription: Your account does not have access to this workbench. Ask an administrator to enable it and try again.
permissions.capabilitiesRequired: Your account cannot view the workflow catalog. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.chatRequired: Your account cannot send tasks to the Agent. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.enterpriseDecideRequired: Your account cannot decide this approval. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.enterpriseResumeRequired: Your account cannot resume this task. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.browserCreateRequired: Your account cannot run browser tasks. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.browserDecisionRequired: Your account cannot approve or reject this step. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.browserCancelRequired: Your account cannot cancel tasks. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.browserArtifactsListRequired: Your account cannot view task artifacts. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.browserArtifactsViewRequired: Your account cannot download task artifacts. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.agentRequired: Your account cannot access the AI Agent workbench. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.knowledgeViewRequired: Your account cannot view knowledge documents. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.knowledgeManageRequired: Your account cannot ingest knowledge documents. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.knowledgeSearchRequired: Your account cannot search the knowledge base. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.tasksGetRequired: Your account cannot view task details. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.tasksDecideRequired: Your account cannot decide task approvals. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.tasksResumeRequired: Your account cannot resume tasks. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.tasksCancelRequired: Your account cannot cancel tasks. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.workflowsViewRequired: Your account cannot view workflows. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.workflowsRunRequired: Your account cannot run workflows. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.assistancePredictRequired: Your account cannot request AI assistance. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.assistanceFeedbackRequired: Your account cannot submit AI assistance feedback. Ask an administrator to enable access.
permissions.assistanceDashboardRequired: Your account cannot view the AI assistance dashboard. Ask an administrator to enable access.

overview.title: Agent operations overview
overview.runtimeHint: Capabilities are loaded from the enterprise runtime.
overview.securityHint: Sensitive tool calls remain subject to explicit approval.

chat.title: Enterprise Agent chat
chat.description: Submit a task, inspect its result, and approve sensitive tool calls before they run.
chat.emptyDescription: Ask the agent to inspect inventory risk, review supplier records, or analyze operations. It will request approval before high-risk tools run.
chat.placeholder: Describe the task you want the Agent to complete…
chat.hint: Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line. This conversation stays on the current page.
chat.pausedDescription: Review the tool and arguments before deciding. Approval is recorded first; the task owner must then resume the task explicitly.

assistance.title: AI assistance recommendation
assistance.humanConfirmation: This operation may be high risk. AI only provides guidance; human confirmation is still required before execution.
assistance.usePrompt: Please use the following runbook to analyze the issue and recommend the next safe action:

dashboard.title: AI assistance closed-loop monitoring
dashboard.description: Inspect feedback coverage, knowledge usefulness, model drift and slice performance.
dashboard.slicesDescription: Compare precision, recall and false positives/negatives by role, module and workflow.
dashboard.noSlices: There are not enough samples for this dimension.

browser.formDescription: Choose a workflow and provide the target system and structured input.
browser.sensitiveApprovalHint: The BFF still requires human approval for sensitive actions.
browser.emptyTasks: No browser tasks yet. Choose a workflow and submit the first task.
browser.noPendingApproval: The task is waiting for approval, but the service has not returned an approval ID yet.

tasks.title: Unified task center
tasks.approvalHint: Review the operation and arguments before deciding.
tasks.approvedHint: Approval is recorded. The task owner can now resume the enterprise task explicitly.
tasks.enterpriseApprovalHint: High-risk Enterprise Agent actions always require human approval.
